SwordRaise.prompt: A heavy armoured knight raises his right hand from a ready grip to straight overhead in the first 0.3 seconds, as if lifting a greatsword attached later, then holds that pose for the rest of the clip, chest out, feet planted, no swing or jump.

Sigh.prompt: A standing knight lets his shoulders drop in a long heavy disappointed sigh, head tilting down and shaking slowly side to side, then straightens up.

Scrub.prompt: A standing knight holds his right hand in a tool grip at chest height in front of him and scrubs it rapidly side to side, like brushing teeth, feet planted. The toothbrush is attached later; do not create a prop or another character.

FormALine.prompt: A standing armoured adult gives a firm commanding gesture: left arm extends forward at chest height and sweeps inward to order a queue, then returns to ready. Right hand holds an imaginary sword still, feet planted, no walking, no props, no attack swing. Complete the gesture in the first second.

LastJudgment.prompt: A standing armoured adult delivers a grand final verdict: left arm rises dramatically overhead, palm open, then sweeps down authoritatively to chest height in the first second. Right hand holds an imaginary sword still at the side. Feet planted, no jump, no props, no weapon swing, then return to ready.
